changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM c_configuration WHERE name IN ( 'account-number-gap-pool-batch-size', 'startup-gap-scan-fill-size', 'account-number-gap-refill-max-windows', 'account-number-gap-scan-window-size' )

column.name: description
column.value: Master switch: reuse missing client account-number suffixes from the GAP pool before allocating new hi-lo numbers. Enable after SEQUENCE_TABLE is configured.

column.name: description
column.value: Hi-lo block size for SEQUENCE_TABLE allocation. Increase only if client-create throughput needs fewer sequence-table round trips. Default 250.

column.name: description
column.value: Minimum GAP pool size. The maintenance job refills when available unused suffixes drop below this value. Default 10.

column.name: description
column.value: Minutes before an in-flight CLAIM suffix is returned to the GAP pool. Must exceed the longest client-create transaction. Default 60.
